thesis: SPY closed at 730.2 with a 10-session return of -4.77%, a 50-session SMA of 762.28 and 22.88% annualized volatility. The MODERATE tier sets a target of -60% of equity in S&P 500 exposure; SH at 1x daily leverage expresses it with about 60% of equity in cash.
invalidation: The tier is re-evaluated on every completed session: exit or reduce when the tier drops or the direction flips, and 3x holdings exit after the holding-duration limit. Overnight gaps can move the position beyond the 2% daily drawdown brake.
